description: One entry of manifest.models[]. Self-contained: it is copied verbatim into manifest.v0.1.schema.json as definitions.modelDescriptor (the manifest copy is authoritative for validation; a format test asserts the two stay identical). See docs/SPEC-5.5-models-proposal.md. Owned by the Embedded AI lane. Rules the JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by validateWorld: an onnx model MUST give shape+dtype for every input/output (error models.tensor), and deterministic:true REQUIRES a seed (error models.seed).

deterministic.description: True when the same observation sequence always produces the same action sequence. Rules models MUST be deterministic. ONNX models SHOULD be (fixed seed, no sampling).

fallback.description: Id of another model in the same manifest to use when this one cannot run (missing runtime, oversize, failed load). A fallback MUST NOT itself declare a fallback (no chains). The fallback SHOULD be a rules model.

id.description: Stable model id, unique within the manifest. Referenced by other models' fallback.

inputs.description: Observation the model consumes, in order. For "rules" these are named observation fields (shape/dtype omitted). For "onnx" these are input tensors: shape and dtype are REQUIRED and MUST match the graph (enforced by validateWorld, error models.tensor).

range.description: Expected [min, max] of the values (per element for tensors). Players SHOULD clamp inputs to this range.

shape.description: Tensor shape, e.g. [1, 8]. The first dimension is the batch (always 1 in v0.1).

license.description: SPDX id or free text for the model file itself (may differ from the world's license).

outputs.description: Action the model produces, in order. Same shape rules as inputs: tensors for "onnx" (shape+dtype required, error models.tensor), named fields for "rules".

path.description: Relative POSIX path inside the container. Model files MUST live under models/.

purpose.description: What the model does in this world, e.g. "rebounder". Players match models to behaviours by purpose, not by id.

runtime.description: "rules" is a declarative JSON behaviour table, interpreted by the player's built-in rules engine. "onnx" is an ONNX graph run on-device (ONNX Runtime Web, WASM, CPU). No other runtime is valid in v0.1.

seed.description: Deterministic seed (uint32). REQUIRED when deterministic is true. Rules models record it; they use no randomness. ONNX models use it for any sampling/dropout at export time.

sizeBytesMax.description: Hard cap on the model's uncompressed byte size. Defaults by runtime when omitted: rules 65536, onnx 51200 (50 KiB). The validator rejects a world whose model file exceeds its cap.

tickHz.description: How often the player MUST step the model. 1-60 Hz; 10 Hz is the v0.1 default. The player interpolates movement between ticks; the model MUST NOT depend on wall-clock time.

version.description: Model version, semver-ish. A new version of the same model keeps the same id.
